task_description: Fix the entire authentication system in StockFlow: remove broken Google OAuth, redesign login pages (public + staff), remove role selector from registration, add country code picker, add OTP verification, add profile creation on signup, implement role-based routing and sidebar filtering, fix rate limiting UX

Review pass addressed: removed dead loginWithOAuth, extracted shared useLoginForm hook, optimized profile+role into single join query, fixed OTP to use updateUser instead of signInWithOtp, fixed manager access to settings. No OAuth buttons on login page per original requirements.
